title: Temple of Fire
objective: Forge trustworthy tests: stack the test pyramid, expose flaky checks and set quality gates.
intro: Deep in the volcano, the Fire Sage keeps the flame of quality alive. Ganonix has been slipping flaky tests past the guards. Clear five chambers to relight the flame.

trials.title: The Test Pyramid
trials.prompt: Stack the tests from the wide, fast base to the narrow, slow peak.
trials.hint: You want many cheap tests at the bottom and few expensive ones at the top.
trials.success: A sturdy pyramid: lots of fast unit tests, fewer slow end-to-end checks.

trials.title: The Flickering Flame
trials.prompt: This test passes some days and fails others. Flag the lines that make it flaky.
trials.hint: Look for fixed waiting and for anything left to chance.
trials.success: Fixed sleeps and random values make a test unreliable. Wait for conditions and control your inputs.

trials.title: Doubles in the Dark
trials.prompt: Match each kind of test double to its job.
trials.hint: A stub just answers. A mock checks how it was used. A spy watches a real object.
trials.success: You can tell the impostors apart.

pairs.right: Verifies it was called a certain way
Wraps a real object and records calls
A light working version, like an in-memory database

trials.title: The Coverage Curse
trials.prompt: Coverage reads 95%, yet bugs keep reaching players. What is the best explanation?
trials.hint: Coverage counts lines that ran, not whether anything checked the results.
trials.success: Coverage shows what ran, not what was verified.

options.text: The coverage meter must be broken.
options.why: The meter is fine. It measures something narrower than quality.

options.text: Lines ran, but some tests assert little or nothing.

options.why: Chasing the number can produce even more hollow tests.

trials.title: The Quality Gate Room
trials.prompt: Set the merge rules for the main branch.
trials.hint: Gates should block bad changes and flaky tests should be fixed, never hidden.
trials.success: The gates stand firm. Only trustworthy changes pass.
clues: A pull request must pass its tests before merging.
Coverage should not be allowed to drop on a change.
Flaky tests are quarantined and fixed. Failing tests are never deleted to turn the build green.

switches.label: Merge on a failing build when late
Delete failing tests to go green
